description.en_US: Rhythm-game key overlay for the AULA WIN 60 HE keyboard: shows the configured keys as keycaps with live travel depth and actuation point, per-key press counts, total, KPS and peak KPS in a click-through corner overlay. Shows while an osu! map is played by default; reads aulactl feed, which runs only while the overlay is visible.
description.zh_TW: AULA WIN 60 HE 鍵盤的音遊按鍵疊加層：在螢幕角落以不攔截點擊的浮層顯示設定的按鍵鍵帽、即時鍵程深度與觸發點、每鍵次數、總數、KPS 與最高 KPS。預設只在打 osu! 圖時出現；資料來自 aulactl feed，只在疊加層顯示時執行。
description.zh_CN: AULA WIN 60 HE 键盘的音游按键叠加层：在屏幕角落以不拦截点击的浮层显示设置的按键键帽、实时键程深度与触发点、每键次数、总数、KPS 与最高 KPS。默认只在打 osu! 图时出现；数据来自 aulactl feed，只在叠加层显示时运行。
